label: Peplink MAX BR1 Mini M2M (HW3)
description: Compact M2M router, hardware revision 3: 0/1x GE WAN, 2/1x GE LAN, 300 Mbps throughput, Wi-Fi, PoE in.
notes: Vendor figures from the BR1 Mini M2M HW3 datasheet: Ethernet WAN port **0 / 1 (GE)**, LAN port **2 / 1 (GE)** under PrimeCare, Router Throughput 300 Mbps, Wi-Fi AP Yes, PoE Input Yes. **This HW3 M2M is gigabit**, unlike the older MAX BR1 Industrial M2M in this catalogue which has fast-Ethernet ports and a 100 Mbps ceiling - the same product name, a different hardware revision, and a ten-times throughput difference. **PoE: LAN 1 only.** The BR1 Mini M2M HW3 datasheet prints "1x ... Ethernet with 802.3at PoE input" over a two-port LAN row without naming the socket; the hardware reference guide's panel drawing labels the pair "LAN 1 | 2 / WAN" with **802.3at PoE IN** under LAN 1 and the parts list reads "1x GE LAN Port with 802.3at PoE Input". LAN 1 declares `poeIn: 18` (the datasheet's maximum consumption, "13W (nominal), 18W (max.)"), LAN 2 declares `poeIn: false`. Sources: https://download.peplink.com/resources/br1_mini_m2m_datasheet.pdf (datasheet) and https://download.peplink.com/manual/br1_mini_m2m_hardware_reference_guide.pdf (panel drawing and parts list).
